page.overview:
Who is Ten Moogles?

The Ten Moogles is a group of moogles who are temporarily playable in Final Fantasy VI. They live in the mines of Narshe and are led by Mog. Early in the game when Terra is being pursued by the guards, the moogles aid Locke in defending her.

In the Game Boy Advance and original Japanese versions, the ten moogles have names themed on the word "moogle", while in the Super NES version, their names are themed on their signature cry "kupo". The ten moogles consist of:

After her Slave Crown was damaged and Terra was freed from the control of the Gestahlian Empire, she awoke in the care of Arvis. The guards of Narshe still wanted to arrest Terra, so he told her to flee into the mines. The guards cornered Terra and the floor collapsed under her, dropping her in front of the moogles' cave. Meanwhile Arvis contacted Locke to help Terra escape. Locke found Terra shortly before the guards did, but was greatly outnumbered. The moogles emerged from their cave and Locke intuited that they wanted to help him. The moogles and Locke defeated the leader of the guards and Locke escaped the mines with Terra.

Later, Terra passed through the mines again with Edgar and Banon. The two briefly visited the moogles' cave, but the creatures paid them no mind. In the World of Ruin, Mog is the only moogle left in the caves.
